Pronto Soggiorno is an independent app, not affiliated with the Polizia di Stato or the Ministero dell\'Interno. It reads the public status page of questure.poliziadistato.it, the same one you can open in a browser. The official information is always what the portal and the Questura tell you.
The portal says your permit is ready for collection.
The portal says your application is still being processed. We\'ll let you know when it changes.
The portal does not find this number. Check that it is correct: new applications can take some days to appear. If it doesn\'t appear within 30 days, automatic checks will pause.
The portal published a text the app does not recognise. Read it below or open the portal.
The status will appear here after the first check.
the portal took too long to answer
a secure connection could not be established
the connection was blocked for security reasons
the portal answered with an error (HTTP %1$s)
the portal sent an unexpected response
Add the number of your application (pratica) or of your postal receipt (assicurata) and the app will check its status for you.
This application\'s data can\'t be read on this phone
You won\'t be alerted when your permit is ready. You can still open the app to see the status.
Enter the application number (pratica) or the postal receipt number (assicurata). The app recognises which one it is.
Pratica: 10 characters (2 digits, 2 letters, 6 digits). Assicurata: 12 digits.
The number must have 10 characters (pratica) or 12 digits (assicurata).
This format is not valid. Check the number on your receipt.
This number is already in your list.
E.g. \"Me\" or \"Mum\". Shown in the app and in notifications instead of the number.
Where do I find the number?
The pratica number is on the receipt the Questura gave you. The assicurata number is the 12-digit code on the post office receipt you got when you sent the application kit.
The number is stored encrypted on this phone and is only sent to questure.poliziadistato.it to check the status.
Only add numbers that are yours, or that their owner asked you to check.
Wait for the SMS telling you when and where to collect it
\"Open portal\" opens questure.poliziadistato.it in your browser, outside this app.
Shown exactly as the portal publishes it, in Italian.
The last check failed: %1$s. It will be retried automatically.
You just checked. Try again in a minute.
Its number and history will be removed from this phone.
Its encrypted data can\'t be opened on this phone (for example after restoring the phone). Delete it and add it again.
Checks work on Wi-Fi and mobile data (about 1 KB each). Android may delay them a little to save battery. The status changes over days: checking more often doesn\'t make it faster.
If off, you\'ll only be notified when the permit is ready.

What is stored: the numbers you add, the names you give them and the check history. Everything stays on this phone; numbers and names are encrypted with a key kept in the Android Keystore. Android backups of this app are turned off.

Where it is sent: each check sends the number only to questure.poliziadistato.it, the public portal of the Polizia di Stato, over an encrypted connection (HTTPS).

What does not exist: accounts, servers of ours, analytics, advertising.

Find out when your permesso di soggiorno is ready, without checking the portal every day.
No accounts, no servers, no analytics, no ads. Numbers are stored encrypted on this phone and sent only to the Polizia portal.
Allow notifications so the app can tell you when your permit is ready. Notifications show only the name you choose, never the number.
Without notifications you\'ll need to open the app to see the status. You can change this later in Settings.
Paused: number not found for 30 days

The portal hasn\'t found this number for more than 30 days. Check that it is correct; if it isn\'t, delete it and add it again. You can still check by hand: if it appears, automatic checks restart on their own.
